name: ensemble
description: Multi-model agent ensembles. Scenes (one TypeScript file) define nodes — any model, typed shared state, tool-using agents, human/agent approval pauses — wired by conditional edges and executed over OpenRouter.

routines.jury: node src/cli.ts run dev/.ensemble/scenes/jury.mts "Should a two-person team start a new internal tool on SQLite or Postgres?" --budget 0.10
routines.trivia: node src/cli.ts run dev/.ensemble/scenes/trivia.mts "Run a fun 5-question trivia night" --budget 0.30

panes.name: run
panes.description: Primary pane for executing scenes: `node src/cli.ts run scenes/<scene>.mts "<goal>"`. Runs are long-lived and stream per-node output, so keep this pane dedicated to them.

panes.name: check
panes.description: Typecheck and validation loop: `npx tsc --noEmit` and `node src/cli.ts validate scenes/*.mts`. Validation is free, so run it here before spending tokens on a run.

panes.name: shell
panes.description: Free shell for ad-hoc work — editing scenes, inspecting .ensemble/runs/<id>/state.json, or checking `ensemble models`. Kept empty so the run pane is never interrupted.

panes.name: topology
panes.description: Render scene topology: `node src/cli.ts view scenes/<scene>.mts` for the terminal sketch, `--mermaid` for diagram source, or `--html=g.html` for a browser view.

panes.name: artifacts
panes.description: Inspect run output under .ensemble/runs/<timestamp>-<scene>/ — `state.json` is the checkpointed blackboard, `result.md` renders every state key.
